verdict.rationale: Synthesia documents natural-language operation for video creation: an AI Assistant turns a prompt into a finished video, and Synthesia MCP lets users create and find videos from Claude or ChatGPT. Documented natural-language control covers only creating and finding videos, not the rest of the product, and all evidence is vendor-claimed. missing for 10: documented natural-language control of editing, translation/dubbing, workspace and asset management; detail on which MCP tools exist; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Turn any prompt, link, or file into a polished video with helpful AI Assistant.
Write a prompt and add context. Get a finished video.
You can also use Synthesia MCP to create and find videos from AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT, without calling an API yourself.
